messages:
larry-peopleops: Heads up PDX: elevator 2 is out of service until further notice. If you have mobility needs please do not use stairs. We're arranging an accessible shuttle from the lot to the lobby starting in 20m. :wheelchair:
nina-pdx: I'm on 6th floor with a new hire and a heavy monitor 1. Can security help move it?
oliver-hr: Onboarding today at 3pm was scheduled onsite. I'll switch to virtual and ping the new hires.
sophia-facilities: Elevator fault code: E2-HTR. Maintenance onsite ETA ~45m. We're coordinating an escorted carry-down for hardware and a shuttle for folks who can't use stairs.
sam-security: Security can assist with escorted descents in teams of two. Please fill this quick form so we can prioritize: https://forms.internal/reentry (or DM me).
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED 1 INC-2026-358 | Elevator outage PDX. Owner: facilities. Priority: high for accessibility.
larry-peopleops: Shuttle details: runs every 15 minutes from the north lot -> lobby from 2:40pm-5:00pm. To request pickup, DM @sam-security with your name and floor.
oliver-hr: For managers: approve flexible check-ins for today and allow new hires to join remote. If badge/card access is needed for escorted pickup, DM me.
sophia-facilities: If you left personal items upstairs, please coordinate with security for pickup windows. There's a 10-person capacity on the shuttle at a time.
larry-peopleops: Expense guidance: we will cover taxi/shuttle for accessibility reasons. Use code PDX-ELEV and attach receipts. For security-escorted hardware moves, log a ticket to facilities and tag it FAC-7891.
ops-bot: UPDATE INC-2026-358 | Maintenance on-site, diagnostic in progress. Next update 30m.
larry-peopleops: Quick note: managers 1 please be proactive about people who have long commutes or mobility devices. If you need to book a private accessible ride, DM @larry-peopleops.
nina-pdx: Thanks all, appreciate the quick response. Helping the hire down now with security.
larry-peopleops: I'll post a final sign-off when the elevator is back or at 5:30pm PT.
